svg.aria-label: Architecture: the gatherer fetches the data, then a ticker fans out to eight specialist agents, three at a time, reading it from one cache; the orchestrator combines a deterministic weighted score with an LLM memo and live catalysts into one verdict, persisted to SQLite and JSON.
